$comment: Pack map for the directory packs published to testland/qa-skills. Every plugin that owns skills or agents is in exactly one pack. Build with `make packs`; see packs/README.md.

packs.name: testland-essentials
packs.description: Core QA workflow for any team: test strategy and planning, test data and environments, test review against conventions, test reports and CI results, CI integration, and flaky-test triage.
examplePrompts: Review this test file against our test conventions and list what to fix.
This test fails one run in ten on CI. Find the cause and propose a fix.
Write a risk-based test plan for the checkout redesign.

packs.name: testland-backend
packs.description: Testing backend and distributed systems: async jobs and queues, caches, concurrency and race conditions, database migrations, distributed tracing, feature flags and experiments, sagas and CQRS, serverless functions, and time and timezones.
examplePrompts: Write a test that proves this lazy initialisation has no race condition.
Check this database migration for locking and data-loss risk before we run it.
Our background job runs twice after a retry. Write tests that catch it.

packs.name: testland-api
packs.description: Testing APIs and integrations: REST API tests, consumer-driven contracts, GraphQL, gRPC, auth flows (OAuth, OIDC, Keycloak, Auth0, Okta), real-time protocols, email and push notifications, and payment flows.
examplePrompts: Write contract tests between our web app and the orders API.
Add tests for the OAuth authorization-code flow with PKCE.
Test our Stripe webhook handler against retries and duplicate events.

packs.name: testland-security
packs.description: Security testing and compliance: SAST, DAST, dependency, secret and SBOM scanning, infrastructure-as-code checks, fuzzing, compliance controls, test-data privacy, and multi-tenant isolation tests.
examplePrompts: Add dependency vulnerability scanning to our CI and tell me which findings matter.
Scan this repo's history for leaked secrets and set up a pre-commit check.
Write tests proving one tenant can never read another tenant's data.

packs.name: testland-web
packs.description: Testing web front ends: browser end-to-end tests, visual regression, accessibility, localization, PDF and print output, browser extensions, and progressive web apps.
examplePrompts: Set up Playwright end-to-end tests for our sign-up flow.
Audit this page for WCAG 2.2 accessibility issues and write tests for them.
Add visual regression checks to our component library.

packs.name: testland-unit-testing
packs.description: Unit and code-level testing: unit tests for JavaScript and TypeScript, Python, JVM, .NET, Go and Rust, mutation testing, property-based testing, BDD, and CLI tool tests.
examplePrompts: Write pytest unit tests for this module, including edge cases.
Run mutation testing on this package and show which tests are too weak.
Add property-based tests for this date-parsing function.

packs.name: testland-ai
packs.description: Testing AI and data systems: LLM evaluation and red-teaming, ML model tests, search relevance, AI-assisted test generation and review, and data quality checks.
examplePrompts: Build an evaluation suite for our RAG chatbot's answers.
Add a regression gate so a retrained model can't ship if it got worse.
Write data quality checks for this pipeline's output table.

packs.name: testland-mobile-desktop
packs.description: Testing native apps and devices: iOS and Android, desktop apps, embedded and hardware-in-the-loop systems, and games.
examplePrompts: Set up Appium tests for our Android login screen.
Write UI tests for our Electron desktop app.
Plan hardware-in-the-loop tests for this firmware update.

packs.name: testland-performance
packs.description: Performance, resilience and production checks: load testing, chaos and resilience drills, synthetic monitors, canary validation, and release runbooks.
examplePrompts: Write a k6 load test for our checkout API with pass/fail thresholds.
Plan a chaos experiment for losing one database replica.
Check whether this canary is safe to promote.

packs.name: testland-manual-testing
packs.description: Manual and exploratory testing: test design techniques, exploratory charters and sessions, bug reproduction and reports, defect tracking, and test case management.
examplePrompts: Write an exploratory testing charter for the new search filters.
Turn these notes into a bug report with clear reproduction steps.
Design test cases for this form using boundary values and decision tables.

packs.name: testland-leadership
packs.description: Quality leadership and planning: QA team management and reporting, test impact analysis, code-quality gates, and shift-left reviews of specs and designs.
examplePrompts: Write this week's quality status digest for the leadership team.
Which tests should run for this change? Use test impact analysis.
Review this spec for testability before the team starts building.
